description:
The list of device compliance scripts associated with the tenant.

TIP: Gets a specific Intune custom compliance script by ID. By default detectionScriptContent is NOT returned — pass $select=id,displayName,detectionScriptContent,runAsAccount,enforceSignatureCheck,runAs32Bit,... to fetch the base64-encoded PowerShell body. Supports $select and $expand.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-device-compliance-script
